name: support-faithfulness-eval
description: Held-out support questions with the policy text each answer must stay inside, for faithfulness scoring.
notes: These are the eval_dataset.create inputs: enter name, description and tags in the plan's input form (the same shape is a POST /eval-datasets body; the owner is always the signed-in account). Aria creates the EMPTY versioned test set. The 30 example rows are in dataset/faithfulness-cases.jsonl and are added separately (POST /eval-datasets/{id}/examples, or + Add example on the test set's page): adding rows is not an Aria capability.
